items.question: By what count and in what setting are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count is set among thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings are stated to be tormented in that setting.
items.inference: Torment is assigned to beings located within eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: Which class of beings is meant remains implicit from this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
